settings.heading: Shipping and delivery
settings.content: Orders are dispatched within 48 hours. Standard delivery takes 7 to 14 business days depending on your country. You will receive a tracking link by email as soon as your parcel leaves the warehouse.

settings.heading: Returns and refunds
settings.content: If it is not right for you, email us within 30 days of delivery and we will walk you through the return. Refunds are issued to your original payment method once the item is on its way back to us.

settings.heading: Free worldwide shipping
settings.text: Every order ships free with tracking, wherever you are.

settings.heading: 30-day guarantee
settings.text: Not for you? Send it back within 30 days for a full refund.

settings.heading: Support that replies
settings.text: A real person answers every email, usually within a day.

settings.title: Exactly what I hoped for
settings.body: Arrived faster than I expected and the quality is genuinely better than the photos. I have already ordered a second one.
settings.author: Sarah M.

settings.title: Worth every penny
settings.body: I was nervous ordering online but the whole thing was smooth. Tracking updated the whole way and support answered me the same day.
settings.author: Daniel R.

settings.title: Really happy with it
settings.body: Took about ten days to reach me, which they were upfront about. No complaints at all, it does exactly what it says.
settings.author: Amelie D.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders leave our warehouse within 48 hours. Delivery usually takes 7 to 14 business days depending on your country, and you get a tracking link by email as soon as it ships.

settings.question: What if it does not fit or I change my mind?
settings.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to request a return for any reason. Email us and we will send you instructions and a refund once the item is on its way back.

settings.question: Can I track my order?
settings.answer: Yes. As soon as your parcel leaves the warehouse we email you a tracking number and a link to follow it.
